rules.routeSplit: split the route at the first hyphen; left is origin and right is destination
rules.inheritRoute: a blank route cell inherits the nearest previous nonblank route within the same sheet region
rules.lssAndRemarks: preserve LSS text and remarks in 运价备注
rules.missingYear: use run_year from the run manifest
rules.validity: 运价有效开始时间 is run_date and 运价有效结束时间 is ETD
rules.negativePrices: preserve negative values and emit a review issue
